scope: Bounded new-repository/source pass. Search-result leads are distinguished from opened sources and downloaded numeric datasets. Not internet-wide exhaustion.

items.name: One-Nanometer Transistor Gate
queries: "one nanometer" transistor gate microscopy data download Berkeley
items.decision: DOE page supplies a schematic and TEM cross-section image, not a reusable calibrated 3D device/gate dataset.

items.name: Blu-ray Track Pitch
items.decision: NNCI lesson points to scan images, but the current landing page supplies PDF teaching material; no compatible licensed, vertically calibrated numerical scan obtained.

items.name: DVD Track Pitch
items.decision: AFMWorkshop cookbook teaches acquisition and NNCI supplies lesson PDFs; neither inspected route yielded a verified reusable numeric height field for the item.

items.name: Spider Silk Fiber
items.decision: New CC BY numerical AFM deposit inspected: resin-embedded polished fiber cross-sections and their subregions, not intact strand exterior. No extrusion or invented strand depth.

items.name: Dust Mite
items.decision: No new qualifying complete specimen mesh identified in these maker/museum searches; commercial illustrations and unrelated art do not resolve the previous anatomy/calibration failures.

items.name: Cat Flea
items.decision: New search results describe SEM photographs, artwork or non-geometric data; no complete reusable adult specimen surface acquired. Prior NC scan not restaged.

items.name: Paedophryne Amauensis
items.decision: Alternate-deposit search returned prior oVert literature and unrelated anatomy studies, without a new directly downloadable rights-verified whole-body surface. MorphoSource challenge not retried.

items.name: Bumblebee Bat
items.decision: New result trail concerns skull/ear or nasal anatomy, not an acquired full-body mesh. Prior DigiMorph unavailable downloads not retried.

items.name: Bee Hummingbird
items.decision: No new exact-species reusable whole-body model identified. Robotic ornithopters and CT of ruby-throated hummingbirds are different objects/species.

items.name: Titan Beetle
items.decision: New trails concern antennal SEM, dimensions or maker indexes; no complete species-identified reusable specimen mesh found. Prior unavailable Sketchfab asset not retried.

items.name: Vivian Hailstone
items.decision: No new compatible-licensed numerical shape release identified. Prior NCAR/UCAR terms and failed candidates retained; no unrelated hailstone substituted.

items.name: Queen Alexandra's Birdwing
items.decision: No new complete female species-identified mesh with permitted rights and wingspan calibration identified; prior Adobe asset not acquired.

items.name: Meganeura
items.decision: LambOfCAD's articulated printable exists, but its source listing uses a custom commercial license rather than CC BY/CC0. No model downloaded.

items.name: Wandering Albatross
items.decision: New results were commercial other-species prints, isolated wing studies or avian cranial data; no qualifying complete spread-wing wandering albatross obtained.

items.name: Giant Pacific Octopus
items.decision: New scanning literature includes disarticulated octopus parts or paralarvae; no source establishes a complete adult spread-arm calibration. Prior folded scan not restaged.

items.name: Titanosaur Cast
items.decision: AMNH describes cast preparation but exposes no verified permitted full-cast mesh; newer anatomical studies target isolated bones. eLife lead returned a client challenge, not an acquired asset.

items.name: Giant Siphonophore
items.decision: No new compatible full-colony source identified. Prior MBARI NC-SA assets and wrong-species Nanomia candidate not restaged.

items.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
items.decision: Open Heritage search returned other pyramids, not a qualifying new Giza source. Previous metric/completeness and original-height versus footprint blockers remain; no scan restaged.

items.name: Lituya Bay Megatsunami
items.decision: New Zenodo release supplies simulation video/code and solid-body STL terrain; this is not a measured 1958 run-up boundary or wave surface. No archive acquired.

items.name: Dinkinesh
items.decision: No new authoritative numerical shape release with clear version/frame/rights identified by this alternate-deposit query. Existing NAIF/PDS attempts not repeated.

items.name: Mount Thor Cliff
items.decision: No new measured cliff-face surface identified; ordinary single-valued terrain cannot resolve the known overhang. Existing rejected DEM not re-registered.

items.name: Lake Baikal Depth
items.decision: New deposit trail includes sediment/radiocarbon data rather than a qualifying depth-focused scene. Existing ETOPO candidate and footprint/framing decision retained.

items.name: Mauna Kea
items.decision: No new scan resolving the existing height-versus-footprint conflict identified. Existing true-scale ETOPO candidate remains unregistered; no terrain rebuild.

items.name: Kola Superdeep Borehole
items.decision: New trail concerns tomography of extracted rock samples, not the underground bore path/depth. Neither a rock sample nor wellhead can be scaled to bore depth.

items.name: Large Hadron Collider Ring
items.decision: New GitHub search surfaced general accelerator resources, without a verified complete surveyed coordinate release. No lattice-derived path or circle created.

items.name: Channel Tunnel
items.decision: No new compatible surveyed bored-tunnel alignment/profile identified. Prior surface rail-link archaeology and guessed routes not reused.

items.name: Hunga Tonga Eruption Plume
items.decision: Search returned the already documented stereo-retrieval family. Existing candidate needs owner integration/representation review; this pass did not acquire or re-register it.

items.name: Danyang-Kunshan Grand Bridge
items.decision: New archived tour-KMZ lead describes composite tracks at an artificial viewing elevation; original geometry rights and surveyed bridge endpoints not verified. No route acquired.

items.name: Mammoth Cave
items.decision: New ionajo/maca project explicitly maps the entrance and above-ground landscape, not the cave's accumulated passages. Other scan leads are fragments, not a full length-calibrated network.

items.name: Longest Lightning Flash
items.decision: New repository search returned the certification literature, without a verified downloadable certified event/group-coordinate set. Prior empty NOAA prefix not retried.

items.name: Typhoon Tip
items.decision: No new qualified georeferenced wind-field geometry identified; no inference of wind diameter from cloud imagery.

items.name: Earth's Inner Core
items.decision: NASA result is an interior graphic with JPEG/TIFF downloads, not a downloadable source mesh; another ready cutaway result is explicitly NC. No sphere authored or whole Earth scaled as the core.

items.name: Contiguous US Longest Distance
items.decision: Carried forward: endpoint pair and entirely-within-US definition remain unresolved in terrain3d2. No new source search or guessed geodesic; preserve photo.

items.name: Trans-Siberian Railway
items.decision: New atlas distinguishes CC BY waypoint-era geometry from ODbL OSM traces. Waypoint joins are not a measured rail alignment; other network data explicitly uses ODbL and may choose a different route.

items.name: TON 618 Event Horizon
items.decision: Carried forward from deepsky3d: mass-derived horizon size does not supply observed surface geometry. No new source search or authored black-hole primitive.

items.name: Milky Way Central Bar
queries: "A Three-dimensional Map of the Milky Way Using 66,000 Mira" data catalog
items.decision: New CC BY catalog acquired and plotted: real distance-estimated stars, but no isolated full long-bar membership; fixed-window plots retain disk/bulge stars and survey gaps. No fitted density sampled or 10-kpc boundary asserted.

items.name: Fermi Bubbles
items.decision: New spatio-spectral work still describes angular gamma-ray maps/models; no qualified measured spatial lobe volume acquired. No sky-template extrusion.

items.name: Magellanic Stream
items.decision: New search did not supply complete measured distances for the gaseous stream. Cloud-star distance maps and sparse stellar tracers are not the full gas geometry.

items.name: IC 1101
items.decision: New results concern imaging/surface-brightness profiles and central spectroscopy; no reusable full volumetric stellar distribution acquired.

items.name: Andromeda Gas Halo
items.decision: No new full measured spatial halo product identified in alternate-deposit search. Prior integrated-sightline limitation retained.

items.name: Porphyrion
items.decision: Alternate-deposit search did not yield a new compatible data release; paper search returns the already known on-request particular data and Code Ocean route. No challenge retry or author contact.

items.name: Distance to the Virgo Cluster
items.decision: Carried forward from deepsky3d: observer-to-cluster distance is not cluster size; existing catalog cannot simply be rescaled. No new source search.

items.name: Baryon Acoustic Oscillation Scale
items.decision: Carried forward: BOSS candidate already exists in deepsky3d and was deliberately unregistered. Owner review of its interpretation, not a missing public source; no re-registration.

items.name: Putative Giant Arc
items.decision: New critique/simulation literature does not supply the exact cleaned observed membership or resolve derived-catalog terms. No exploratory group promoted as the claimed arc.

items.name: Hubble Radius
items.decision: Carried forward from deepsky3d: a derived distance scale has no measured surface. No new source search, sphere or scale diagram.

items.name: JADES-GS-z14-0
items.decision: Carried forward from deepsky3d: imaging/redshift do not provide an observed 3D source for the observer-distance marker. No new source search or extruded galaxy.
